tests.name: MariaDB migration: four InnoDB sidecars and FK enforcement enabled
Complete archived document: active/history/attachment/out-of-prefix/direct files; audit retained; repeated resume exactly once
Existing unbound files remain untouched and no manifest is finalized
Cross-document shared file blocks the entire cleanup without reassigning metadata
Different legacy alias blocks cleanup; document number is never sufficient
Crash after manifest; wrong namespace pending; fresh engine reads identical manifest and completes in correct bucket
Finalized manifest tamper is rejected before IO
Crash before manifest is non-destructive and safely resumable
Partial provider timeout remains durable UNKNOWN; repeated resume cannot repeat unknown delete or hard delete DB
Two workers: connection-owned advisory claim allows only one external destructive step
DB rollback restores all metadata and final audit; retry needs no duplicate storage IO
Lost response after DB commit: durable completion and final audit are read without duplicate IO
Crash after durable IN_FLIGHT but before IO remains Pending; expired worker is not proof of completion
Crash after provider ACK but before durable evidence remains UNKNOWN; never infer success from absence
Local sandbox: unsupported race-safe deletion persists REJECTED and retains all metadata/files
Evidence and diagnostic connections remain independent when all business slots are occupied
Concurrent reservation identities are idempotent or rejected, never duplicated
Crash after storage before database transaction resumes without duplicate external IO
Owned missing object remains safely idempotent through exact-key provider ACK
Normalized cross-document key alias blocks cleanup even when raw storage keys differ
No unrelated baseline business row changed or disappeared; globals/FK checks remain unchanged
